title: Scrambled Eggs
description: Soft scrambled eggs. 2 to 3 eggs per person.
steps: Whisk eggs with 1 Tbsp whole milk per 2 eggs and a pinch of salt.
Melt 1 Tbsp butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low.
Pour in eggs. Let sit 20 seconds, then slowly push from the edges to the center with a spatula. Keep going.
Pull off the heat while they still look slightly wet; they finish on the plate. Pepper to taste. Optional: a handful of shredded habanero jack in the last 30 seconds.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R12
notes: 5 min. Breakfast timing: start hash browns (R2) and sausage (R13) in the oven first; eggs go last.
